# Community bootstrap fallback: the keys of the mainnet nodes that run the community node.
#
# The node reads this file when config.ini sets no [community_bootstrap] confidants= (see
# docs/differences.md, "Community bootstrap fallback"). If no block, round or regular bootstrap comes
# for stall_minutes (default 10) and no neighbour is ahead, these nodes may restart the network
# without the official nodes; a restart needs more than half of them (4 of 6) holding the last
# block. Every node that should take part needs the same list: do not edit it by hand (a new
# package replaces it); set confidants= in config.ini for your own list, or enabled=false to turn
# the fallback off.
#
# Chosen on 2026-11-28 (owner decision: the nodes that today announce the community version), each
# with at least 500,000 CS of stake (balance + delegations; MinStakeValue, 50,000, is what a key
# needs to sign a round). Evidence: knowledge note "Community Bootstrap Fallback", 2026-11-28.
